<think>**Refining distributed priority encoding**

**Designing radix-4 winner tree**

**Preserving fallback parameters**

**Refining helper logic**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module pe16_parallel (
    input wire [15:0] x,
    output wire valid,
    output wire [3:0] encoded,
    output wire [15:0] winner,
    output wire [15:0] enable
);
    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin : gen_suffix
            if (i == 15) begin : top_bit
                assign enable[i] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : other_bit
                assign enable[i] = ~(|x[15:i+1]);
            end
            assign winner[i] = x[i] & enable[i];
        end
    endgenerate
    assign valid = |x;
    assign encoded[3] = |x[15:8];
    assign encoded[2] = (|x[15:12]) |
                        ((~(|x[15:8])) & (|x[7:4]));
    assign encoded[1] = (|x[15:14]) |
                        ((~(|x[15:12])) & (|x[11:10])) |
                        ((~(|x[15:8])) & (|x[7:6])) |
                        ((~(|x[15:4])) & (|x[3:2]));
    assign encoded[0] = winner[15] | winner[13] | winner[11] |
                        winner[9] | winner[7] | winner[5] |
                        winner[3] | winner[1];
endmodule

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
    parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
    parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

    generate
        if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast256
            wire [15:0] group_valid;
            wire [15:0] group_enable;
            wire [15:0] group_winner;
            wire [3:0] group_encoded;
            wire [3:0] local_encoded [0:15];
            wire [15:0] local_winner [0:15];
            wire [15:0] local_enable [0:15];
            wire [15:0] low_terms [0:3];
            genvar g, b;
            for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : blocks
                pe16_parallel local_pe (
                    .x(input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16]),
                    .valid(group_valid[g]),
                    .encoded(local_encoded[g]),
                    .winner(local_winner[g]),
                    .enable(local_enable[g])
                );
                for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encode_terms
                    assign low_terms[b][g] = local_encoded[g][b] & group_enable[g];
                end
                if (g == 0) begin : bottom_block
                    assign output_unencoded[15:1] = local_winner[g][15:1] & {15{group_enable[g]}};
                    assign output_unencoded[0] = group_enable[0] & local_enable[0][0];
                end else begin : remaining_blocks
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16 +: 16] = local_winner[g] & {16{group_enable[g]}};
                end
            end
            pe16_parallel group_pe (
                .x(group_valid),
                .valid(output_valid),
                .encoded(group_encoded),
                .winner(group_winner),
                .enable(group_enable)
            );
            assign output_encoded[7:4] = group_encoded;
            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encode_reduce
                assign output_encoded[b] = |low_terms[b];
            end
        end else begin : general_tree
            wire [W-1:0] padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
            wire [W/2-1:0] v [LEVELS-1:0];
            wire [W/2-1:0] e [LEVELS-1:0];
            genvar l, n;
            for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : pairs
                assign v[0][n] = |padded[n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_first
                    assign e[0][n] = !padded[n*2];
                end else begin : high_first
                    assign e[0][n] = padded[n*2+1];
                end
            end
            for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : levels
                for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : nodes
                    assign v[l][n] = |v[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                    if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_first
                        assign e[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = v[l-1][n*2] ?
                            {1'b0,e[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:n*2*l]} :
                            {1'b1,e[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                    end else begin : high_first
                        assign e[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = v[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                            {1'b1,e[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                            {1'b0,e[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:n*2*l]};
                    end
                end
            end
            assign output_valid = v[LEVELS-1];
            assign output_encoded = e[LEVELS-1];
            assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The previous candidate serializes local encoding, group encoding, a group-indexed 16-way encoded-data mux, and portions of the one-hot decode. The indexed mux and encode-then-decode paths are the principal targets.",
  "rewrite": "Use parallel suffix-absence logic within sixteen 16-bit blocks and across the sixteen block-valid signals. Generate one-hot outputs directly from local winners and higher-block absence. Replace the indexed local-encoding mux with four parallel masked-OR reductions. Compute upper encoded bits directly from block-valid priority equations. Handle output_unencoded[0] directly as absence of every higher input, avoiding a late invalid-output correction.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by eliminating the serial group-indexed mux and binary-to-one-hot decoding. Local encoding and higher-block exclusion evaluate concurrently. Numerical improvement and electrical-violation status require the specified mapping and STA flow; neither has been measured here.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel suffix reductions trade additional reduction logic and enable buffering for shallower selection paths. Shared suffix expressions and removal of variable shifts and indexed selection are intended to keep area within the 8862.124480 um2 cap, but mapped area and zero slew/capacitance violations remain unverified.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For the assessed WIDTH=256, LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0 instance, the highest asserted input determines both encoded and one-hot outputs. With all inputs zero, output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=1, exactly matching the original. All 256 input bits remain unrestricted. Module ports and parameter declarations/defaults are preserved; a general-tree branch retains the original behavior outside the specialized configuration. The design is entirely combinational."
}
